document_summary: This document is a plan of approach for an internship at the HZ University of Applied Sciences, focusing on the KMP (Kennis Management Platform) where the author will be working as a data scientist. The main topics include background information about the organization and its mission, structure, and educational activities; the problem statement regarding the manual input required to upload unstructured project documents into the platform; and the objective of designing and implementing a Proof of Concept (PoC) for NLP techniques to automate this process.

results_or_conclusions: The internship aims to design and implement a Proof of Concept that demonstrates how NLP techniques can support the KMP uploading process.
The main objective is to reduce manual effort in the document uploading process by automatically generating project information.

The data science pipeline will be developed to transform uploaded documents into JSON-based text representations, preprocess them using NLP models like BERT for summarization and key content extraction.
